git add packages/daemon/src/routes/validation.ts packages/web-ui/src/lib/api.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(web-ui): fix validate page runtime error from undefined traitCycles

The daemon route handler at /api/validate was accessing result.traitCycles,
but the validate() function returns traitCycleErrors. This caused traitCycles
to be undefined in the JSON response, which threw "Cannot read properties of
undefined (reading 'length')" when the client accessed validation.traitCycles.length.

Fixed the daemon route to use result.traitCycleErrors, and added defensive
normalization in fetchValidation() to default missing array fields to empty
arrays, preventing similar crashes if the API shape changes.

Spec: @ui-validation-view

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
